entries.title: Activity shows one line for a memory warning, and none for a sign-in no project uses
entries.body: A memory warning used to fill Activity with a row for every task, most of them using nothing. It is now one line naming the computer and the task using the most memory. A host your projects do not live on, such as GitLab when you only use GitHub, no longer writes a line each time it briefly cannot be reached.
entries.noPicture: The memory line appears only while macOS reports memory pressure with tasks running, which the app's isolated test launch cannot stage.
